+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
+OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+
+
+def _document_to_data_url(document_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "application/pdf") -> str:
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(document_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def extract_tables_from_document(document_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "application/pdf", extra_instructions: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = "Extract table structure from this document. Return a JSON object with tables, rows, and cells preserving cell text, row order, and column spans if present."
+    if extra_instructions:
+        prompt = f"{prompt} {extra_instructions}"
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _document_to_data_url(document_bytes, mime_type)}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+    try:
+        return json.loads(content)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"tables": [], "raw": content}
+
+
+def extract_tables_from_file(path: str, mime_type: Optional[str] = None, extra_instructions: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        document_bytes = f.read()
+    if mime_type is None:
+        lower = path.lower()
+        if lower.endswith(".png"):
+            mime_type = "image/png"
+        elif lower.endswith(".jpg") or lower.endswith(".jpeg"):
+            mime_type = "image/jpeg"
+        elif lower.endswith(".webp"):
+            mime_type = "image/webp"
+        else:
+            mime_type = "application/pdf"
+    return extract_tables_from_document(document_bytes, mime_type=mime_type, extra_instructions=extra_instructions)
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_VISION_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_VISION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
+OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png") -> str:
+    encoded = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    return f"data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def extract_text_from_document_image(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png", extra_instructions: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    prompt = "Extract plain text from this scanned document image. Preserve reading order and line breaks."
+    if extra_instructions:
+        prompt = f"{prompt} {extra_instructions}"
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_VISION_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": _image_to_data_url(image_bytes, mime_type)}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "temperature": 0,
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+def extract_text_from_file(path: str, mime_type: Optional[str] = None, extra_instructions: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        image_bytes = f.read()
+    if mime_type is None:
+        lower = path.lower()
+        if lower.endswith(".jpg") or lower.endswith(".jpeg"):
+            mime_type = "image/jpeg"
+        elif lower.endswith(".webp"):
+            mime_type = "image/webp"
+        else:
+            mime_type = "image/png"
+    return extract_text_from_document_image(image_bytes, mime_type=mime_type, extra_instructions=extra_instructions)
+
*** End Patch
